title: Creator collaboration and photography permissions
summary: How creators and SpotFinder can share useful place photography responsibly.

body.text: Editorial outline: Explain the actual collaboration process after the owner confirms it. Describe licensing, attribution, withdrawal requests, and photo authenticity in plain language.

items: Confirm the real contact path and permission terms with the owner.
Get written licenses for every example image.
Do not imply a creator partnership that does not exist.
